keyPhrases.text: Unfortunately, Underwood sticks to one note, and that's brutish
it often feels as if we're watching a fundamentally nice actor baring his teeth
Stanley's rage at the world doesn't come from deep inside
Stanley also needs to have a feral charm and a touch of insecure neediness

reasoning: Harsh criticism of the lead performance with no positive elements. The review systematically dismantles the actor's portrayal, calling it one-note, unconvincing, and lacking emotional depth. This is clearly negative criticism.
